name: Portable Electric Citrus Juicer | USB Rechargeable Hands-Free Fruit Extractor for Fresh Juice Anywhere
description:
Make juicing effortless with the Portable Electric Citrus Juicer. Compact, wireless, and USB rechargeable, it’s perfect for oranges, lemons, grapefruits, and more. With one-touch hands-free operation and up to 90% juice yield, you get maximum freshness in minutes. Detachable parts make cleaning simple, while its lightweight design is ideal for home, office, or travel use.
Key Features
 USB-C rechargeable with long battery life
 One-touch hands-free juicing for convenience
 Extracts up to 90% juice with minimal pulp
 Detachable parts for quick and easy cleaning
 Food-grade ABS+AS, BPA-free, safe to use
 Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design
Ingredients / Materials
Food-grade ABS + AS, stainless steel filter
How to Use
 Cut fruit in half and place on juicer cone
 Press button for automatic extraction
 Collect juice in the built-in container
 Detach and wash parts after use (wipe motor base only)
Package Includes
 1 × Portable Electric Citrus Juicer
 1 × USB-C Charging Cable
 1 × Cleaning Brush
